name: @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime
_comment: Fixture, not a dependency. lib/sandbox.sh reads the installed SRT's version by resolving `srt` through its symlink and walking up to the package.json — `srt --version` reports 1.0.0 regardless of the release. This mirrors npm's global layout (<prefix>/lib/node_modules/<pkg>/dist/cli.js) so the suite exercises that walk instead of stubbing it.
